title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook and quality gating
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Summary: Adds a new CI hook and quality-gating layer to the eval-harness that runs prompt-set regression checks on PRs touching prompt definitions or evaluation configs. Motivation: We observed intermittent regressions in prompt outcomes after model rollouts; the goal is to prevent accidental quality regressions by surfacing per-prompt delta metrics in PR CI and blocking merges when thresholds are exceeded.

What this PR does: 1) New GitHub Actions job (eval-prompt-regression) that runs a lightweight eval subset across the changed prompt sets and computes per-prompt accuracy/delta metrics against a baseline. 2) Adds a gating step that compares metric deltas to thresholds defined in eval/configs/quality_gates.yaml and fails CI when regressions exceed allowed tolerances. 3) Integrates with the existing eval-harness metrics exporter so CI posts a short summary comment on the PR with top regressions and a link to the full artifact. 4) Adds documentation and a troubleshooting guide for maintainers on how to update baselines and interpret gate failures. 5) Small test harness and mock fixtures so the job can run under the repo's self-hosted runners without requiring GPU.

Design notes: - The CI job is intentionally lightweight: it uses a curated subset of prompts and small eval targets to reduce cost and latency while still catching obvious regressions. - Thresholds are configurable per-prompt-group; defaults are conservative and live in eval/configs/quality_gates.yaml. - Full eval and golden-run artifacts are stored in actions artifacts and in the internal S3 bucket when run on main. - The gating logic permits an opt-in override by adding the label "eval:force-merge" for emergency merges, but such merges are logged and require post-merge follow-up.

Files and places changed (high level): - GitHub Actions workflow: .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml - Eval harness: eval-harness/ci/prompt_regression_runner.py - Quality gate config: eval/configs/quality_gates.yaml - PR comment poster: tools/ci/post_eval_summary.py - Docs: docs/eval-harness/ci.md - Tests: eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_regression_runner.py - Fixtures: eval-harness/tests/fixtures/simple_eval_fixture.json

Testing: Unit tests added for the gating comparator and end-to-end smoke test that runs the workflow locally with the mock runner. CI run on this PR passes all checks after one flaky retry of the smoke test (infra transient).

Risks and mitigations: - False positives in the gate: mitigated by conservative defaults and a clear remediation flow; maintainers can update baselines after manual verification. - CI runtime: kept under 10 minutes by using small eval subsets and caching.

Related: ENG-1428 (prompt-regression-gating), ENG-1434 (eval-harness infra improvements), SUP-721 (customer reported regression alert).
commits: a1b2c3d: initial implementation of prompt_regression_runner and test fixtures
d4e5f6a: add GitHub Actions workflow and GHA matrix for runners
b7c8d9e: integrate quality_gates.yaml and gating comparator
c0ffee1: add post_eval_summary helper to comment on PRs and upload artifacts
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Nice work. Left a few small nits around logging and a question about default thresholds - can we make those explicit in docs?
Aisha Patel: replied: updated docs to include default thresholds and added a link to baseline management in the troubleshooting section.
Priya Singh: request changes: please add an integration test that simulates a small regression and ensures the gate fails deterministically.
Aisha Patel: replied: added smoke test that injects a deterministic regression using the fixture and asserts the gate fails; moved expensive tests behind a pipeline tag.
Ethan Zhao: approved: verified workflow file and ensured artifacts are scrubbed for PII before upload.
release_notes: Adds CI-level prompt-set regression checks and a configurable quality-gating layer to the eval-harness. This introduces a lightweight GitHub Actions job that will block merges when per-prompt regressions exceed configured tolerances. Operators should review eval/configs/quality_gates.yaml and update baselines as needed.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on the gating comparator logic (eval-harness/ci/gating.py), the threshold semantics in quality_gates.yaml, and the PR comment output format. The workflow is intentionally conservative; tuning will follow after initial rollout.
post_merge_actions: Monitor CI failures for first two weeks and collect false-positive reports
Publish a short runbook for updating baselines and emergency override label
Schedule a follow-up to expand prompt coverage if gate proves stable
